Written by Matthias in Projects , Sabbatical Exactly one year ago I was challenged with a diary that should also include experiences from the age of five. While I certainly lack notes from that early in my childhood, I actually have made some efford to document my life. Can I consolidate all the scattered information from websites, projects, paper copies, photo albums and apps like Instagram? Statistics: Days covered: 660 Total entries: 1733 Total words: 470,112 Total reading time: 39h 11m The automatic scanning of my project websites is not yet finished. Maybe I should revisit this idea in one year. I hope by then I have the 4 stages defined, a web interface to manage the sources, and respective JSON files for each stage and each source. The idea is there, the implementation needs time. PKM Personal Knowledge Management That’s what Obsidian, Notion and Logseq are usully describe tools for. Since I worked with MarkDown since 2018 I decided to use Obsidian. Currently it has already 161 articles with 72,590 words. It would take 4h33 to read. Here is the graph: And if I highlight one article from this web it looks like: I’m curious what results I have next year.
